**Claimant:** House Republicans (all) + one Democrat; championed by President Trump
**Source:** [NPR — SAVE America Act Explainer](https://www.npr.org/2026/02/19/nx-s1-5719252/trump-voting-save-america-act-explainer) | Bias: Center-left
**Documentation:** [Full bill text via Congress.gov / H.R.4894-era comparison](https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/4894/text); [White House statement](https://www.whitehouse.gov/articles/2026/03/the-save-america-act-is-the-most-popular-election-reform-in-decades/) | Primary sources available.

**Coverage gap:** Coverage is broad across spectrum but framing diverges sharply — right-leaning outlets emphasize polling support; left-leaning outlets emphasize disenfranchisement risk.

**Notes:** Bill passed House; faces filibuster obstacle in Senate (60-vote threshold). Brennan Center estimates 21 million citizens lack ready access to qualifying documents.
